scripts.build: npm run build:public && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:public: rm -rf dist/public && mkdir -p dist/public && cp -R public/. dist/public/
scripts.build:admin: cd adminprashoes && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist/adminprashoes && mkdir -p dist/adminprashoes && cp -R adminprashoes/dist/. dist/adminprashoes/
scripts.check: node --check public/app.js && cd adminprashoes && npm run check
